name: Notes Card
description: A task list app screen, drawn inside a phone: a card that fills the display and carries its own tab bar, so the navigation belongs to the thing it navigates rather than floating beside it. Built on a design system stated once: two type pairs — 16px with medium, 14px with normal — where selection is signalled by surface and colour rather than by a third size, and letter-spacing rides on the type token so the same size is never set two ways in two components. Radii are concentric and the arithmetic is checkable: 16 on the card, 8 one padding step in, 4 two steps in. Rows are wells recessed with a 1px inset ring rather than a border, and each row ends in a rail of three action buttons whose boxes and gaps divide that rail exactly. The leading mark is a ring filled as a wedge in proportion to subtasks done, drawn on the icon set's own 24 grid at the shared stroke weight. Status pills use `text-box: trim-both cap alphabetic` to centre on their cap height rather than their line box, every control carries a 40px hit area as a pseudo-element that never overlaps its neighbour's, and transitions name the exact properties that change. Colour is OKLCH throughout at hue 264, with the ink value spent in exactly two places — the primary action and the selected tab. Renders entirely on the server.

variations.name: default
variations.description: A task list screen inside a phone shell — status bar, home indicator, and a card that fills the display between them. Header with a primary action, a segmented filter, and date-grouped rows carrying completion, status, counts and a rail of edit/complete/delete actions. Two type pairs, concentric 16/8/4 radii, 40px hit areas on every control, press feedback at 0.96, and transitions that name only the properties that move. The progress mark is a wedge drawn on the icon set's own grid, and the last row sits mid-swipe with its delete action revealed. Static — no hooks, no motion library, zero JavaScript.

props.name: time
props.description: Clock in the status bar. Defaults to "9:41". Set in tabular figures so a different time cannot shift the radios beside it.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes on the scaling root. The device is fixed at a 390 × 844 screen inside a 12px bezel and is scaled to the caller's width by a viewBox, so it shrinks to fit a narrow column and stops at its natural 414px — set a `max-w-*` here to cap it smaller.
